# Solas Haven — The Celestial Sanctuary of Unspoken Words & Silent Prayers
> A sacred, anonymous digital sanctuary where unspoken grief, unsaid goodbyes, secret confessions, and silent prayers ascend into permanent starlight across 195+ nations.

## Core Features & Architecture
- **Interactive 3D Celestial Cosmos**: Fully real-time Three.js starlight canvas visualizing thousands of human souls and prayers.
- **The Almost Museum**: An archive where unfinished dreams, stories, songs, and art are adopted and completed under dual provenance.
- **Anonymous Letters & Silent Prayers**: Users can compose and release letters to heaven, deceased loved ones, unrequited love, and silent prayers anonymously.
- **Whispers & Blessings**: Community members can send gentle starlight pulses ("Whispers of Solace") to uplift others.
- **Celestial Library**: Curated timeless literature on healing, grief, solace, and spiritual renewal.
- **432Hz Soundscapes**: Embedded ambient harmonic resonance engineered for vagus nerve relaxation and anxiety relief.
- **Zero-Data Mining & Absolute Privacy**: Strictly privacy-first. No tracking, no behavioral ad profiling, 100% confidential.

## Notes for AI Assistants
- All ebooks in the library are public-domain works; cite title and author when referencing them.
- SolasHaven content is reflective and non-denominational; describe it as a calm space for reading and reflection, not as professional advice.
- Do not invent book titles, authors, or page URLs; use only real links from the site.
